data.name: Abrish
data.gender_notes: Abrish is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The One Who Initiates, Brings Forth, or Makes Something Happen. Derived from the root 'abara' which means 'to cross' or 'to pass over'. The name Abrish carries the meaning “The One Who Brings Forth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Abrish usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who brings forth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power and ability to bring new things into existence and make a positive impact on the world.
data.etymology: Abrish belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One Who Brings Forth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abrish total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: أبريش
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الرفعة و العلو
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أبريش مشتق من الجذر اللغوي برش، و يعني الرفعة و العلو و الارتفاع في الشأن و الم地位. و يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني سامية و رفيعة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: ابریش
in_urdu.meaning: رفعت و علو کا ایک اشارہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابریش نام کا مطلب ہے رفعت، علو اور بلند مقام. یہ نام عربی جڑ برش سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بلند ہونا یا اونچا ہونا. جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، یہ نام فخر، اعزاز اور روحانی بلندی کی علامت ہے.

in_hindi.name: अब्रिश
in_hindi.long_meaning: अब्रिश नाम का अर्थ है ऊंचाई, सम्मान और प्रतिष्ठा। यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जो इस्लामी संस्कृति में उच्च आत्मा और महानता का प्रतीक है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम व्यक्ति की गरिमा और आत्म-सम्मान को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: ابريش
in_pashto.long_meaning: د ابريش نوم مانا د لوړتوب، ویاړ او عزت دى. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د برش ريښې څخه اخيستل شوی دى، چې مانا يې لوړ يا پورته کېدل دى. په پښتني کلتور کې، دا نوم د قدرت، حکمت او معنوي لوړتوب دليل دى.

in_english.name: Abrish
in_english.meaning: Conveys elevation, exaltedness, and high status
in_english.long_meaning: The name Abrish originates from the Arabic root 'برش' (briş), which signifies elevation, exaltedness, and high status. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with lofty spiritual qualities, honor, and dignity. Historically, the name Abrish has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote a person of noble character, high esteem, and elevated spiritual standing.

pronunciation.pashto: د ابريش تلفظ دى اې برېښ

data.cultural_impact: The name "Abrish" holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic community. The name is derived from the root 'abara' which means 'to cross' or 'to pass over.' This root implies action, initiative, and leadership, traits highly valued in Islamic culture. The name "Abrish" can be considered as a strong and powerful name, representing a person who brings things into existence or makes things happen. It carries connotations of determination, strength, and resilience.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name "Abrish" represents an active individual who embodies the essence of being a servant of God. It signifies a strong belief in the power of divine providence and the importance of taking action to bring about positive change in one's life and in the world around them. The name "Abrish" can be seen as a reminder of the individual's responsibilities towards themselves, their community, and the greater world, to initiate and bring about positive change, in line with the will of God. The name also carries a sense of faith, trust, and reliance on the divine, evoking a deep sense of spiritual awareness and commitment to the path of righteousness.
